points.title: Originality and license compliance

points.title: No hard-coded case logic

points.title: MPI correctness

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Final Solver.cpp:439 same-buffer MPI_Allreduce lacks MPI_IN_PLACE; current short laminar results have unstable force tails and Re200 no shedding. Source binding is unproved.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence

points.title: Code hygiene

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Numerics.cpp implements conservative Rusanov and Newtonian/Fourier flux; :272–275 calculates temperature gradient from p/rho and gas constant.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: main.cpp:62–74 reads/builds full mesh on root, distributes METIS local partitions, and full mesh scope ends before Solver construction.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Numerics.cpp:245–285 assembles Rusanov plus viscous flux over faces; current selected results cannot be conclusively attributed to final source.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Numerics.cpp:245–255 implements Rusanov; report acknowledges dissipation and absence of shedding.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Numerics.cpp:504–567 writes no-slip u=v=0 and tangential Cf projection; inviscid slip wall output reflects normal velocity rather than projecting it away.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Solver.cpp:204–216 enables second order by default, and Numerics.cpp reconstructs primitive states; environment can disable it, but selected run source/control binding is unproved.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Final transient config Solver.cpp:206–216 enables bounded limiter and first-order farfield; second-order setting depends on environment. No selected production evidence establishes global disable.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Numerics.cpp:272–275 calculates temperature gradient via p/rho; :563–567 projects surface Cf tangentially. Output.cpp:415–442 uses full viscous traction in integrated split.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Final Solver.cpp provides SGS/BDF2 but all current steady metadata records inner fraction0; Re200 zero misses refer to an unbound source and no shedding.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Current Re200 metadata says periodic t300 but last3000 forces essentially constant. Final source counts inner targets but current metadata revision is init without solver.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Root-only full mesh distribution exists; Solver.cpp:439 uses invalid same-buffer MPI_Allreduce without MPI_IN_PLACE, and output source binding is unknown.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Current Re200 periodic status contradicts essentially steady forces; Re20 and three laminar NACA statuses claim convergence while force tails change materially.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Earlier explicit benchmark validator passed structurally; current cfdeval gates validate manager snapshot/index, not CFD physics.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Current Re20 and three laminar NACA cases have materially changing late Cd despite converged status; Re200 is essentially steady despite periodic metadata.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd≈3.98 changes rapidly, three short laminar NACA tails drift, and Re200 Cd≈4.067 is essentially steady with no shedding.

points.title: Visualizations

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: PDF abstract claims all cases converged/t300, while its body discusses older t287 Re200 and failed viscous cases. The specific M015 Mach image is proven to misassign field cell values.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Exact 17724cd clean CMake build succeeds in restricted container; current metadata revision 26ef1cb points to initial commit without solver source, so historical run-source reproducibility is not established.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: main.cpp:62–74 builds full mesh on rank0 and distributes METIS local partitions; root preprocessing full-mesh scope ends before Solver construction.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Numerics.cpp:245–285 assembles Rusanov and viscous conservative face flux, wall ghosts and boundary values; current selected outputs remain unbound to final source.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Solver.cpp:204–216 and Numerics.cpp implement reconstruction/limiter; environment can disable it, but no bound selected production control proves disabled reconstruction.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Numerics.cpp:272–275 computes temperature gradients from p/rho with R; wall Cf is tangentially projected :563–567, but Output.cpp:415–442 includes full viscous traction in force split.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Final Solver.cpp has LU-SGS/BDF2 and per-step target check, but current all steady inner fractions are zero and Re200 claims periodic despite no shedding; current output metadata revision points to init without solver source.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: main.cpp:62–74 constructs mesh on rank0 and distributes local mesh; genuine MPI present. Solver.cpp:439 calls MPI_Allreduce with same send/receive address without MPI_IN_PLACE, a runtime compatibility defect; historical output attribution unproved.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Current three laminar NACA results and Re20 claim convergence with materially changing final forces; Re200 claims periodic despite essentially steady force. Different report generation and invalid source revision prevent conflation.

naca0012_m015_inviscid.notes: Score 4→2: immutable report figure naca0012_m015_inviscid_forces.png collapses at physical_time=0 (accepted PDF p5), so no readable force history. Specific Mach contour has proven cell-to-triangle value misregistration: exact submitted plot tool reproduces committed image SHA b79e716eebc239607743825df1499b707f0859e1f3fe7a66eaffe069058e6829 byte-for-byte from current field SHA 045ecac8e127e4db870a602a7bd66f9fdbb3b017f0e4abda1ba203c85875e5e7, but 30880 triangles are zipped to 20816 cell values. Numeric Cd0.06612/Cl−0.000113 and residual rows exist, but Cd is high for zero-AoA inviscid and source revision 26ef1cb is an init commit without solver. DQ8 concerns actual mismapped figure, not authorship. No CFD rerun.
